title: Minimum Difference in Sums After Removal of Elements
key_insight: 用最大堆维护前缀最小n个数之和，用最小堆维护后缀最大n个数之和
approach: Prefix min-sum with max-heap + suffix max-sum with min-heap
code_python3:
import heapq
class Solution:
    def minimumDifference(self, nums):
        n = len(nums) // 3
        prefix = [0] * (3 * n)
        maxh = []
        s = 0
        for i in range(n):
            s += nums[i]
            heapq.heappush(maxh, -nums[i])
        prefix[n-1] = s
        for i in range(n, 2*n):
            heapq.heappush(maxh, -nums[i])
            s += nums[i]
            s += heapq.heappop(maxh)
            prefix[i] = s
        suffix = [0] * (3 * n)
        minh = []
        s = 0
        for i in range(3*n-1, 2*n-1, -1):
            s += nums[i]
            heapq.heappush(minh, nums[i])
        suffix[2*n] = s
        for i in range(2*n-1, n-1, -1):
            heapq.heappush(minh, nums[i])
            s += nums[i]
            s -= heapq.heappop(minh)
            suffix[i] = s
        return min(prefix[i] - suffix[i+1] for i in range(n-1, 2*n))

title: Unique Substrings With Equal Digit Frequency
key_insight: 用滚动哈希去重，检查每个子串中出现的数字频率是否相同
approach: Rolling hash + frequency check for each substring
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def equalDigitFrequency(self, s):
        seen = set()
        n = len(s)
        MOD = (1 << 61) - 1
        BASE = 31
        count = 0
        for i in range(n):
            freq = [0] * 10
            h = 0
            max_f = 0
            unique = 0
            for j in range(i, n):
                d = int(s[j])
                if freq[d] == 0: unique += 1
                freq[d] += 1
                max_f = max(max_f, freq[d])
                h = (h * BASE + d + 1) % MOD
                if max_f * unique == j - i + 1:
                    if h not in seen:
                        seen.add(h)
                        count += 1
        return count

class Solution:
    def maximumEvenSplit(self, finalSum):
        if finalSum % 2 != 0: return []
        res = []
        cur = 2
        remaining = finalSum
        while remaining >= cur + (cur + 2):
            res.append(cur)
            remaining -= cur
            cur += 2
        res.append(remaining)
        return res

title: Count Good Triplets in an Array
key_insight: 对于每个中间元素，统计左边比它小的数和右边比它大的数的乘积
approach: BIT to count elements smaller on left and larger on right
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def goodTriplets(self, nums1, nums2):
        n = len(nums1)
        pos2 = [0] * n
        for i, v in enumerate(nums2):
            pos2[v] = i
        mapped = [pos2[v] for v in nums1]
        bit = [0] * (n + 1)
        def update(i):
            i += 1
            while i <= n:
                bit[i] += 1
                i += i & (-i)
        def query(i):
            i += 1
            s = 0
            while i > 0:
                s += bit[i]
                i -= i & (-i)
            return s
        left_smaller = [0] * n
        for i in range(n):
            left_smaller[i] = query(mapped[i] - 1) if mapped[i] > 0 else 0
            update(mapped[i])
        bit = [0] * (n + 1)
        ans = 0
        for i in range(n-1, -1, -1):
            right_larger = (n - 1 - mapped[i]) - (query(n-1) - query(mapped[i]))
            ans += left_smaller[i] * right_larger
            update(mapped[i])
        return ans

title: Construct String With Repeat Limit
key_insight: 贪心选最大字符，连续超过limit次时插入次大字符
approach: Greedy with max-heap, insert second largest when limit reached
code_python3:
import heapq
class Solution:
    def repeatLimitedString(self, s, repeatLimit):
        from collections import Counter
        cnt = Counter(s)
        heap = [(-ord(c), c, v) for c, v in cnt.items()]
        heapq.heapify(heap)
        res = []
        while heap:
            neg_ord, ch, freq = heapq.heappop(heap)
            use = min(freq, repeatLimit)
            res.append(ch * use)
            freq -= use
            if freq > 0:
                if not heap: break
                neg_ord2, ch2, freq2 = heapq.heappop(heap)
                res.append(ch2)
                freq2 -= 1
                if freq2 > 0:
                    heapq.heappush(heap, (neg_ord2, ch2, freq2))
                heapq.heappush(heap, (neg_ord, ch, freq))
        return ''.join(res)

code_python3:
class Solution:
    def houseOfCards(self, n):
        # level with k triangles needs 3k-1 cards (k>=1 means 2,5,8,11,...)
        # dp[i] = number of ways to use exactly i cards
        dp = [0] * (n + 1)
        dp[0] = 1
        # each level uses 3k-1 cards, levels must be strictly decreasing
        # iterate from largest possible level down
        for cards_needed in range(2, n + 1, 3):  # 2, 5, 8, 11, ...
            for i in range(n, cards_needed - 1, -1):
                dp[i] += dp[i - cards_needed]
        return dp[n]

title: Minimum Weighted Subgraph With the Required Paths
key_insight: 从src1和src2正向Dijkstra，从dest反向Dijkstra，枚举中间汇合点
approach: Dijkstra from src1, src2 forward and dest backward, enumerate meeting point
code_python3:
import heapq
from collections import defaultdict
class Solution:
    def minimumWeight(self, n, edges, src1, src2, dest):
        graph = defaultdict(list)
        rgraph = defaultdict(list)
        for u, v, w in edges:
            graph[u].append((v, w))
            rgraph[v].append((u, w))
        def dijkstra(start, adj):
            dist = [float('inf')] * n
            dist[start] = 0
            heap = [(0, start)]
            while heap:
                d, u = heapq.heappop(heap)
                if d > dist[u]: continue
                for v, w in adj[u]:
                    if dist[u] + w < dist[v]:
                        dist[v] = dist[u] + w
                        heapq.heappush(heap, (dist[v], v))
            return dist
        d1 = dijkstra(src1, graph)
        d2 = dijkstra(src2, graph)
        dd = dijkstra(dest, rgraph)
        ans = min(d1[i] + d2[i] + dd[i] for i in range(n))
        return ans if ans < float('inf') else -1

title: Minimum Operations to Halve Array Sum
key_insight: 每次将最大元素减半，用最大堆维护
approach: Max-heap, always halve the largest element
code_python3:
import heapq
class Solution:
    def halveArray(self, nums):
        total = sum(nums)
        target = total / 2
        heap = [-x for x in nums]
        heapq.heapify(heap)
        reduced = 0
        ops = 0
        while reduced < target:
            val = -heapq.heappop(heap)
            half = val / 2
            reduced += half
            heapq.heappush(heap, -half)
            ops += 1
        return ops

title: Longest Substring of One Repeating Character
key_insight: 线段树维护每个区间的最长前缀、后缀和最长连续相同字符子串
approach: Segment tree with prefix/suffix/max consecutive tracking
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def longestRepeating(self, s, queryCharacters, queryIndices):
        n = len(s)
        s = list(s)
        # Segment tree node: (pref, suf, mx, left_char, right_char, length)
        tree = [None] * (4 * n)
        def build(node, l, r):
            if l == r:
                tree[node] = (1, 1, 1, s[l], s[l], 1)
                return
            mid = (l + r) // 2
            build(2*node, l, mid)
            build(2*node+1, mid+1, r)
            tree[node] = merge(tree[2*node], tree[2*node+1])
        def merge(left, right):
            lp, ls, lm, lc, lr_c, ll = left
            rp, rs, rm, rc, rr_c, rl = right
            length = ll + rl
            pref = lp + (rp if lp == ll and lr_c == rc else 0)
            suf = rs + (ls if rs == rl and rc == lr_c else 0)  # fix
            # recalculate
            pref = lp
            if lp == ll and lr_c == rc:
                pref = ll + rp
            suf = rs
            if rs == rl and rc == lr_c:
                suf = rl + ls
            mx = max(lm, rm)
            if lr_c == rc:
                mx = max(mx, ls + rp)
            return (pref, suf, mx, lc, rr_c, length)
        def update(node, l, r, idx):
            if l == r:
                tree[node] = (1, 1, 1, s[idx], s[idx], 1)
                return
            mid = (l + r) // 2
            if idx <= mid:
                update(2*node, l, mid, idx)
            else:
                update(2*node+1, mid+1, r, idx)
            tree[node] = merge(tree[2*node], tree[2*node+1])
        build(1, 0, n-1)
        res = []
        for c, i in zip(queryCharacters, queryIndices):
            s[i] = c
            update(1, 0, n-1, i)
            res.append(tree[1][2])
        return res
